title: Central coast in 5 days
summary: Hue and Hoi An, with Da Nang as the airport. Add Phong Nha only by dropping a day in one of the cities.

days.title: Day 1 — Hue Citadel
days.body: Visit the Hue Citadel and eat bun bo Hue.

days.title: Day 2 — Hue tombs
days.body: Visit the tombs of Minh Mang, Tu Duc, and Khai Dinh.

days.title: Day 3 — Hoi An old town
days.body: Travel to Hoi An and walk the old town from the Japanese Covered Bridge.

seoDescription: Hue, Hoi An, and the Da Nang airport in five days.
